findings.details: Dependency-free probe checks three workflow env values, external target_directory and source stability. It selects Cargo through ambient shutil.which; it does not exercise the workflow fetch step or GITHUB_PATH selection. Deleting cache warm-up would not be detected by this probe. The current workflow does contain explicit locked-Cargo fetch and PATH publication.
findings.evidence_limit: The existing 10 passed tests establish path isolation and installed-payload integrity controls, not cold-cache end-to-end CI execution.
